# Trip log

An invented document of [minimal-sections.des](minimal-sections.des), DESL's smallest page of sections (DESL 0.4, section 7.8). The trip is a record; the stops are a list ordered by time, with the departure and the arrival emphasised on the time strip, a travel time of 4 h 30 min beside the title, and a mark on the second stop, which has no note.

## Trip

- Weekend in the hills traveller:Sam

## Stops

- 2026-11-20T08:00:00+01:00 departure: Home
  Left before the traffic.
- 2026-11-20T10:15:00+01:00 Coffee in the village
- 2026-11-20T12:30:00+01:00 arrival: Hut
  Keys under the stone by the door.
